test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Sally drives a mini school bus. She starts at the school gate and drives 7 km north for her first pick-up. She then turns right and drives 10 km picking up children along the way. She takes another right turn and drives 5 km. She then takes a final right to return to the school. How far would Sally need to drive to reach back to the school gate again?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sally drives a mini school bus. She starts at the school gate and drives 7 km north for her first pick-up.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adb2513dc21a89a9ef1c6c7fc2dd6794415f52ba8f17e51b4db5b7f9d1e2949c.png] 

2) She then turns right and drives 10 km picking up children along the way. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20c3f6947ea6408043d54b239223d93c1f7e76322c911ebfcb22433c6e3a474f.png] 

3) She takes another right turn and drives 5 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ee9eb770880e971bea1b0d14f918d8b70ff886cd2f2a285d164c31d5eabd04.png&q
uot; style=] 

Distance Sally need to drive to reach back to the school gate again → **(10 km west + 2 km south) = 12 km.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"12 km".**
